headline: As of 2026-10-29: 41,293,476 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+10.4 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 41,293,476 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+10.4 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (5,972,696), California (4,288,495), Florida (3,897,018).
